user.t:
Fix the SPARC Phase 4 gate findings for the nightly pipeline in C:\Users\mariu\neural-mesh (Windows, git master, HEAD at or after 4ead714).

**Ground rules**
- Other sessions and two other fix agents (front-end in llm/frontend*, llm/hook.py; bench in bench/) are working in this checkout. Stage only your own files, using explicit paths.
- Re-read every file before editing it. Never revert other people's work.
- Make one local commit per fix and never push. End each commit message with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>
- Do not make real model, Ollama, npx or network calls.
- Run `llm/.venv/Scripts/python -m unittest` (llm and ingest suites) before each commit.

**Fixes**
1. **Blocker, AC-2.** Add a test to `ingest/tests/test_mirror.py` for a dry-run mirror. Setup: a memory/outcome that still contains a SECRET-class string after scrub, e.g. an `sk-ant-…` style key, an AWS key or a private key block (match it to the patterns `ingest/scrub.py` actually classifies as secret). Assertions:
   - `python -m ingest mirror --dry-run`, called in-process, drops that record from the batch file;
   - the stats count the drop;
   - no secret substring appears anywhere in the batch file.

   Also add a positive control: a normal record is kept.
2. **N1.** Add `.swarm/` to `.gitignore`. The mirror now defaults to `<repo>/.swarm/memory.db`, so this prevents private memories from being committed. Do NOT delete the existing untracked `.swarm/`.
3. **N3.** In `llm/promote.py:~173-180`, a failed `--force` re-promote of the version currently in production must never `ollama rm` the live tag. Skip the rm when the tag equals `production.ollama`, or when it was not created in this call. Add a test.
4. **N5.** Write refused (exit 5) and busy (exit 75) mirror runs to `mirror_runs.jsonl` with their exit code and reason. Add a test.
5. **N4.** In `llm/nightly.py`, handle an older candidate that was evaluated but never decided in the abandoned sweep: when a newer candidate exists, mark it `abandoned/superseded`. Add a test.
6. **N6 (if simple).** Make `run_ingest.ps1 -Detach` append to `ingest-runs.log` instead of truncating it. Extend the Ps1 test.

**Final report:** commits (sha + subject) and test counts.

handback.t:
All six fixes are in, one local commit each, nothing pushed. I staged only my own files by explicit path. The ingest and llm suites both passed before every commit, except one run before the N3 commit (details at the end).

**Commits (oldest first):**
- `343f496` ingest mirror: AC-2 test - dry-run drops SECRET-class records (sk-ant, AKIA, private key) from mirror_batch.jsonl, counts them in stats.dropped_secret, no secret substring in the batch file; positive control keeps normal records
- `e722612` gitignore .swarm/ (N1): the mirror defaults to <repo>/.swarm/memory.db, keep private memories out of git
- `fb682e7` llm promote (N3): a failed promotion never 'ollama rm's the live production tag (production / synthetic_production .ollama) nor a tag that existed before the call (e.g. failed --force re-promote of the production version); tests for create- and cp-failure
- `92c460f` ingest mirror (N5): refused (exit 5) and busy (exit 75) runs are appended to mirror_runs.jsonl with exit code, reason and ts; test
- `366aac9` llm nightly (N4): the abandoned sweep also supersedes an older candidate that was evaluated but never decided when a newer candidate exists (action abandoned, reason superseded); tests
- `150ef31` run_ingest.ps1 (N6): -Detach re-runs the script hidden in the foreground mode (ingest only, -NoMirror), so it appends to ingest-runs.log instead of truncating it via Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput; Ps1 test

**Test counts:**
- **ingest** (`unittest discover -s ingest/tests -t .`): 69 tests, OK. It was 68 at the start; the AC-2 tests are in that 68 because they were added before the first run.
- **llm** (`unittest discover -s llm/tests -t .`): 126 tests, OK at the last run. It was 114 at the start; I added 7 and the other agents added the rest.
- **Checked against old code:** I re-ran the new tests against each file's pre-fix version. They fail there and pass with the fix (AC-2, N3, N4, N6).

**Notes per fix:**
- **AC-2:** this was more than a test. `build_batch(cfg, stats=None)` in `ingest/mirror.py` now records `stats["dropped_secret"]`, and the mirror stats always include it. The new test class `DryRunSecretDrop` in `ingest/tests/test_mirror.py` calls the real CLI entry point in-process (`main(["--data", <tmp>, "mirror", "--dry-run"])`).
  - It uses three secrets: an `sk-ant-` key, an `AKIA` key and an RSA private-key block. They are built from string pieces so no literal key sits in the source, and the test first checks that `ingest/scrub.py` classifies each one as secret.
  - It asserts `dropped_secret == 3`, that the dropped keys are missing and that no secret substring appears anywhere in `mirror_batch.jsonl`.
  - The positive control checks that all 8 normal records are kept.
- **N1:** the existing untracked `.swarm/` was not touched; it is now ignored.
- **N3:** before importing, `promote.run` notes the live tags (`production.ollama` and `synthetic_production.ollama`) and whether the tag already exists in Ollama (one extra `ollama list`). After a failure it only runs `rm` on a tag this call created. The tests are in `llm/tests/test_release.py`:
  - a failed `--force` re-promote of production, for both create and cp failure, leaves the live tag in place;
  - a tag that existed before the call is not removed;
  - a tag the call created is still removed.
- **N5:** a new `_log_run` helper writes refused, busy and normal runs to `mirror_runs.jsonl`. Every row, including normal runs, now carries a `ts` field. Dry runs and the "npx missing" exit are still not logged.
- **N4:** the change is in `abandoned_sweep` in `llm/nightly.py`. Tests in `llm/tests/test_nightly.py` cover the case, plus a control: a single evaluated but undecided candidate stays pending.
- **N6:** the detached run now goes through `Invoke-Logged` / `Write-Log`, so it appends and adds timestamped "ingest run exit N" lines. It also no longer writes the `.err` side file. The new test in `llm/tests/test_scripts.py` starts two detached runs with the stub Python and checks the earlier log content survives and both runs are appended. Against the old script it failed with the log truncated.

**Before the N3 commit,** one llm run showed a failure and an import error. Both were in the front-end agent's files they were editing at the time (`llm/tests/test_frontend_eval.py` and `llm/tests/test_frontend_shadow.py`), not in mine. All later runs were green.

Uncommitted changes from other agents were left alone: `bench/sandbox.py`, `bench/tests/test_sandbox.py`, `llm/frontend_eval.py`, `llm/tests/test_frontend_eval.py`.
